set.body:
Objective
Eliminate all known core ownership and view-semantics contradictions before any public API freeze.

Acceptance criteria
- Borrowed structural views retain BorrowedNDArray provenance.
- Every operation returning NDArray from borrowed input demonstrably owns its storage.
- Read-only kernels no longer require an ownership-erasing NDArray facade.
- narrow has one checked, exact, documented normalization contract across owned, borrowed, and mutable arrays.
- An ownership state-machine suite and composed-layout model suite cover the corrected behavior on JVM and Scala.js.
- All child tickets and their regression tests are closed.
set.title: EPIC: Make core ownership and view semantics release-safe
